thread:
maria-cs: FYI escalated ticket #43217 from Acme — multiple customers seeing 504s and 5xxs hitting hosted inference endpoints since ~09:10 UTC. They report long tail timeouts and no errors before the spike. :rotating_light:
kevin-oncall: pulling logs now, can you share example request ids or timestamps from the ticket?
maria-cs: ticket has request ids: r=acme-req-9921, acme-req-9933. Customer says retries see immediate 5xx, sometimes 504 from our gateway. They attached curl:
```
curl -v -H "Authorization: Bearer REDACT" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"model":"rwd-large","prompt":"hello"}'
```
Response: upstream timeout, gateway 504.
jamie-support: I see correlated alerts from gateway: gateway-proxy reported upstream timeout to inference-svc at 09:11:08, 09:11:22, 09:12:01. Queue depth spiked around the same time.
kevin-oncall: I'm seeing autoscaler events. KEDA fired but pods are slow to become Ready. kube events show: `Pod "inference-xyz-5" failed readiness probe` repeatedly, then `PodStarted`, then long NYI logs.
peter-sre: what do the readiness probes look like? If a probe is failing for long time, KEDA/HPA won't mark pod as ready for service.
dmitri-runtime: model init logs show large model being pulled and mmap warmup happening: `Loading weights... 1.8GB`, then `initializing kv-cache`, then long GC-ish pauses. No Docker image pull issues. This looks like model cold start.
nana-ml: typo — ana-ml: confirmed — the model variant rwd-large is ~2GB CPU+memory footprint; on hot path we expect ~45s init on these instance types. If KEDA scales from 0 -> 1 on demand, that 45s becomes the critical warmup window.
kevin-oncall: KEDA config for this deployment: scaledObject pollingInterval=30s, cooldownPeriod=300s, minReplicaCount=0. HPA threshold targetCPU 40% with minReplicas 0. We effectively scale from 0 -> 1 and traffic hits gateway before readiness.
maria-cs: customer says they saw sustained 5xxs for ~4 minutes. They want immediate mitigation and root cause.
jamie-support: immediate mitigation options: 1) temporarily increase minReplicas to 2 for the deployment; 2) flip route to fallback model variant (rwd-small) until we fix warmup; 3) add temporary per-customer rate limit. Which should we do now?
kevin-oncall: I'm going to manually scale to 3 replicas now to remove cold start tail. `kubectl scale deploy/inference-rwd-large --replicas=3 -n hosted-inference` — doing it.
(autodeploy-bot): deployment/inference-rwd-large scaled
kevin-oncall: waiting for pods to become Ready... seeing Readiness succeed now, backfills showing fewer 5xxs. Maria, pls update customer about temporary scale up.
maria-cs: updated customer and paused automatic alerts for them. They confirmed error rate dropped after ~90s. They want a long-term fix.
peter-sre: long-term fixes to consider: - set minReplicaCount >=1 for critical routes; - reduce KEDA pollingInterval to 5-10s for hot routes; - set activationThreshold lower or use external metrics (queue length) instead of CPU; - set pre-warm pool (always-on minimal instances); - bake model into image to reduce init time.
nana-ml: ana-ml: also consider using startupProbe vs readinessProbe: startupProbe allows longer init without failing readiness sense and avoids churn. But it only affects probe behavior; it doesn't stop traffic hitting pod until Ready is true. We need to ensure gateway waits or route has fallback.
dmitri-runtime: engineering notes: we should add a tiny HTTP warmup handler that returns 200 quickly while model loads in background and mark readiness only after model is usable. But that risks serving partial results — need guard rails. Better: pre-initialize model in an init container during image start when minReplicaCount >0, or maintain warm pool.
peter-sre: also check node-level autoscaler. If nodes are saturated, pods will Pending and we hit timeouts. Right now nodes have headroom but model pod init consumes memory and sometimes OOMs reschedule.
kevin-oncall: action items (short): 1) make minReplicaCount=1 for production critical deployments (temporary) — DONE?
kevin-oncall: patching scaledobject: `kubectl patch scaledobject inference-rwd-large -p '{"spec":{"minReplicaCount":1}}'` — applied.
dmitri-runtime: create a mitigation task: bake model into image (ticket INF-782) and pre-pull images to nodes in regions with heavy traffic.
peter-sre: infra task: tune KEDA pollingInterval to 10s and activationThreshold to 1 request for critical scaledObjects (task SRE-614). Also add metric adapter for queue length (nginx upstream queue or gateway queue) to drive scaling instead of just CPU.
jamie-support: ops follow-up: rate-limit per-customer back to 10 r/s for Acme until warm pool is live. I'll coordinate with CS.
maria-cs: customer satisfied with temporary scale and rate-limits, wants ETA for permanent fix. Giving them ETA ~2 weeks for baked image + KEDA tuning.
action: assign owners: dmitri-runtime -> INF-782 (baked images & pre-pull), peter-sre -> SRE-614 (KEDA tuning & metrics), ana-ml -> ML-90 (model init optimization + smaller variants), kevin-oncall -> monitor and docs update.
kevin-oncall: retrospective notes: avoid 0->1 scaling for critical public endpoints. Prefer minReplicaCount>=1 or a warm pool. Also document per-route safety knobs in runbook.
maria-cs: thanks all. Closing thread once owners are in task tracker and timeline confirmed. :white_check_mark:
